where_we_are: v0.2.0, public and green. All three components done, plus SUBAGENT co-tenancy, which was the real gap: a subagent shares its session's index and no registry can see it (same session_id, same CLAUDE_PID) -- the evidence is `agent_id` in the hook payload. 25 acceptance cases (0 skip), 12 library tests, 9 negative-control mutations all caught, DR-8 as a test, and four real `claude -p` runs (block, warn, subagent, and install-from-GitHub). CI 4/4 on ubuntu and windows. Everything in English; SPEC.md here is the canonical contract.
next: T11 — install on DELL and WORKSTATION from GitHub (parked as a TAREAS item on 24/09)

T13 — let the KB consume the plugin and retire its duplicated hooks; that also closes a real bug in the KB's own hook, which resolves its root from WORKSPACE_ROOT and is therefore blind outside the KB
T14 — the write-up: the instruments that lied in green, with the numbers
waiting_on_albert: T12 — the follow-up comment on anthropics/claude-code#90943 is drafted, not posted. It now has a third point worth more than the plugin: exit 0 + stderr does not reach the model, and agent_id is what makes subagents detectable.

measured.session_identity: (session_id, CLAUDE_PID) — probe-measured across SessionStart/PreToolUse/SessionEnd; process.pid and process.ppid are ephemeral and unusable (D-01)
measured.worktree_scope: linked worktrees share --git-common-dir but have separate indexes (.git/worktrees/<n>/index) — guards use tree scope, the banner uses clone scope (D-07)
measured.real_session: claude -p blocked; the model quoted BLOCKED; 0 new commits (re-run on the tree-scope code, with the fixture carrying toplevel so it exercises the production path)
measured.linux_ci: GREEN. 4/4 matrix jobs, 17 pass / 0 fail / 3 skip on each, verified in the run logs
measured.warn_mode: WARN=1 measured with a falsifiable control: stderr-only -> the model sees nothing (FAIL); hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext -> the model sees it (ok). D-09
measured.transcript_mtime: tracks activity in real time (2 s old while the session was running), so the liveness AND in D-02 is measured, not guessed
measured.install_from_github: claude plugin marketplace add albertgilopez/claude-shared-tree-guards + install -> real claude -p session blocked (test/e2e-real-session.mjs)
measured.cost: Windows, node 22, n=60: fast path +10 ms over a bare node start; solo +64 ms; shared +134 ms. The first measurement said solo cost +331 ms (three git rev-parse spawns before the gate) and that is why resolveRepo() exists.
measured.side_effects: DR-8 as a test: the whole .git and working tree hashed before/after every guard; the only path that changes is <git-common-dir>/claude-sessions/
measured.subagents: measured with a probe hook: a subagent's Bash call DOES reach PreToolUse and carries agent_id/agent_type; the main session's does not. Same session_id and CLAUDE_PID for both, so the registry is blind. Verified end to end with a real subagent and NO other session present (test/e2e-subagent.mjs).
measured.plugin_update: `claude plugin update` compares the manifest version, not commits; the plugin runs from ~/.claude/plugins/cache/<mkt>/<plugin>/<version>/, not the marketplace clone (D-15)

not_doing_and_why.koncepto: no .koncept/ in this repo — a public repo should not ask contributors to learn workspace governance that is not theirs; the invariants are the tests
not_doing_and_why.worktree-guard: does not travel: it encodes one workspace's Tier model and junction layout
not_doing_and_why.KB migration: the KB keeps its own hand-registered hooks until this plugin has flown green for a while (T13); duplicating is safer than migrating today

known_risks: The 8.3-path risk on windows-latest that git.canonical() was written for did NOT materialise: both windows jobs are green. Keep canonical() anyway — it is why.
